The '''"Duraskin" implant''' was a model of [[implant armor]] made by the [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]] and available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The [[Armor/Legends|armor]] cost 7500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="EOTE" />
